articles.title: NHL 27 Is Using AI-Generated Voiceover for In-Game Commentators, John Buccigross Says
articles.summary: EA Sports is using generative AI to create voiceover for its in-game commentators in NHL 27, according to veteran sports commentator John Buccigross. When speaking on the Chirping Zebras podcast (initially spotted by Insider Gaming's Mike Straw ), Buccigross was talking about his experience working…
body: "They're using some AI now; they played me some stuff back of my voice," said Buccigross. "It's like 'Wow, that's pretty good!' If that means less work but the same check, I'll take it. Sometimes AI will get something wrong. One of the guys was playing it back, and a lot of these guys maybe aren't hardcore sports fans; they're video game extrordinares. They're not always up on the vernacular. So they're playing back my AI voice, and they're like, 'Score! And the crowd gets out of their chairs!' I was like, 'No, they're not chairs. They look like chairs, but we call them seats.'

"So, little things like that, you gotta go back and listen because words matter. But then you can make AI smarter; in the future they'll say seats, they won't say chairs. You have to manually put that in. That was kind of a funny anecdote from the process."
points: EA Sports is using generative AI to create voiceover for its in-game commentators in NHL 27, according to veteran sports commentator John Buccigross.
"They're using some AI now; they played me some stuff back of my voice," said Buccigross.
"It's like 'Wow, that's pretty good!' If that means less work but the same check, I'll take it.
So they're playing back my AI voice, and they're like, 'Score!

articles.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Mod Brings Back Classic FF Character Ariana Grande
articles.summary: If you were upset to hear that pop star Ariana Grande wouldn't return in Final Fantasy Resonance, a new mod is here to save the day. In case you were unaware, Square Enix's Final Fantasy Resonance will arrive as the long-running RPG franchise's first proper HD-2D game when it launches next month…
body: The performer behind hits like "break up with your girlfriend, i'm bored," who also played Galinda in the recent Wicked films, isn't a newcomer for the Final Fantasy series. Grande actually joined Final Fantasy Brave Exvius in the form of pixelated characters – including one fit with her Dangerous Woman era bunny outfit – in 2017. The announcement (below) even detailed some in-game love for the pop star's song "Touch It," but when it comes to Final Fantasy Resonance, Grande's contribution to the series will be lost to time.

Producer Keisuke Nakashima recently confirmed to Kotaku that Grande "unfortunately" would not appear in the October Final Fantasy game. At the very least, it sounds like a decision Square Enix put some thought into.
"It’s also part of the worldview, you know?" he told the site. "Ariana Grande’s character would not fit within the vibe that we’ve created for Final Fantasy Resonance."

body: Fall is finally here. The scorching heat of summer is gradually fading into a more pleasant transitional period before winter arrives, as summer blockbuster season makes way for cozy nights on the couch. The summer anime season had plenty to offer, including Science Saru’s Ghost in the Shell adaptation, Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia, and Part 4 of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War. Thankfully, this year’s fall anime lineup looks equally wonderful.
So, without further ado, here are the 10 most anticipated fall anime releases that are perfect for slowing down before winter.

Every sneak peek into Dragon Ball Super: Beerus looks spectacular. An enhanced, remastered, and recut version of early arcs from Dragon Ball Super, Beerus reiterates the beauty of the original series’ fight choreography and the sheer scale of the events that unfold. articles.title: Sebastian Stan Half-Jokingly Pitched a 'Sicario-esque' Bucky Barnes Movie to MCU Boss Kevin Feige
articles.summary: The Winter Soldier himself, Sebastian Stan, recently pitched a " Sicario -esque" Bucky Barnes movie to Marvel Studios leadership. When speaking to New York Magazine, Stan revealed that he pitched Kevin Feige on a solo Bucky Barnes film in the vein of Denis Villeneuve's 2015 movie, Sicario.
body: "We keep a real small budget," said Stan. "It's about a guy who thinks he recognizes someone from his past that had something to do with when, you know, he was brainwashed, and he gets obsessed with this person. He goes on a whole journey to try to figure out who this person is. It's a thriller."

Although the MCU is intricately mapped out, the franchise has always had room to add in these kinds of unique passion projects. Ghost Rider, for instance, is something Ryan Gosling personally campaigned for and pitched to Marvel. The vision for the project was strong enough for Gosling to get the green light, and now, he'll make his MCU debut in summer 2028. Whether Stan's passionate about pursuing this idea enough to make it a reality remains to be seen, but joke or not, the idea does sound like it could be a breath of fresh air for the franchise. It would also put a beloved character front and center after being relegated to a supporting character for over a decade.

articles.title: Pokémon TCG Destined Rivals ETB in Stock at Amazon and Under Market Price
articles.summary: Amazon has restocked the rare Pokémon TCG Destined Rivals Elite Trainer Box for under market price.
body: As I've mentioned in a few different articles today, Amazon has been restocking a whole bunch of rare Pokémon TCG sets for Labor Day, and there are some seriously sought-after sets up for grabs right now. That includes the rare Destined Rivals Elite Trainer Box, which is currently available for just under $116 from Amazon.

I can't remember the last time one of these bad boys was available anywhere near market price from a major retailer. Yes, it's still well above the original MSRP, but that's unfortunately the state of the Pokémon TCG market right now. If you're willing to pay the premium, Amazon is currently one of the better places to pick one up.

TCGplayer has a median listing price of around $150, while its current market price sits at $120.18. Once you factor in delivery costs as well, Amazon's $115.98 price starts to look pretty reasonable, particularly given that it's sold and shipped directly by Amazon.
If you've been waiting for a restock, this is probably one worth considering while the stock lasts. These don't tend to hang around for long when they appear at major retailers.

articles.title: Next Hunger Games Movie 'Sunrise' Confirms Switching Genres in 'Return to Form'
articles.summary: Francis Lawrence has been making Hunger Games movies long enough to bring the series back to a “return to form.” He joined the franchise with Catching Fire in 2013, and now, five films later, November’s Sunrise on the Reaping finds him staging another Quarter Quell in another spectacular arena…
body: But as much as Sunrise goes back to basics, Lawrence and longtime series producer Nina Jacobson were just as excited to finally tell Haymitch’s story, an arc that takes him from an “optimistic kind of carefree kid” to the bitter alcoholic Katniss meets in the first movie. Ultimately, it’s the story of an apolitical young man radicalized into defender of District 12 and beyond. Lawrence sees the film as particularly relevant to the moment.
“When something’s wrong, you have to stand up,” he said. “You have to say something. You have to fight.”

That idea — of Sunrise as both an echo of Catching Fire and the hidden beginning of the revolution Katniss would one day lead — loomed over the gut-wrenching preview footage. So when I had the chance to sit down with Lawrence and Jacobson afterward for an exclusive interview, I jumped at the chance to dig further into how they built that connection.
Francis, you emphasize that Sunrise on the Reaping feels like a return in some ways. What does that mean? Why did The Hunger Games need a return?
points: Francis Lawrence has been making Hunger Games movies long enough to bring the series back to a “return to form.
He joined the franchise with Catching Fire in 2013, and now, five films later, November’s Sunrise on the Reaping finds him staging another Quarter Quell in another spectacular arena…
Ultimately, it’s the story of an apolitical young man radicalized into defender of District 12 and beyond.

articles.title: Fortnite Officially Bringing Mega Man to the Island with Tournament and Skins
articles.summary: Mega Man is still one of the most anticipated Fortnite collaborations coming in Chapter 7 Season 4. It has been teased since the previous season ended, and despite Mega Man items being in the battle royale games, fans are patiently waiting for the skins to be added to Fortnite.
body: Fortnite Override, also known as Chapter 7 Season 4, focuses on two themes: retro games and hacking. This has allowed Epic Games to introduce an array of beloved video game characters to Fortnite. Mega Man was one of the first characters to be teased for this season, as a Mega Man cartridge was inserted into the override console that spawned after the Unstable Event at the Zero Point. However, over two weeks into the season, he has yet to make an appearance.

This is about to change, as a Mega Man Cup will be held on Tuesday, Sept. 8, giving players the opportunity to obtain Mega Man cosmetics for free before they hit the Item Shop. The rules have not been revealed yet, but according to leakers, it is a duos tournament set in Battle Royale, Zero Build, and mobile servers.

Comparing the Mega Man Cup's promotional image to previous Mega Man footage shown in the trailer, it's likely that fans will receive the standard skin as well as the Mega Man X alternative style. Since skins tend to hit the Item Shop not long after they are given away in cups, players can expect Mega Man to become available on Wednesday or Thursday.

articles.title: Persona 1 and 2 remakes are something Atlus will 'probably eventually do', which is great, but the PS2-era Shin Megami Tensei games are sitting right there
articles.summary: Atlus will probably remake Persona 1 and 2 one day, according to a new interview with series producer Kazuhisa Wada conducted by Rock Paper Shotgun. "For me, I think a remaster or remake is some kind of cultural preservation," Wada said.
body: Persona Revelations was released on the original PlayStation in 1996. It's actually been lightly reissued before, in 2009 for the PlayStation Portable, and surprisingly, there's even a 1999 PC port that was never released in the west. While it focuses on a cast of school students, the social links system—arguably the series' best trick—wasn't introduced to the series until Persona 3. It's the Persona game that feels closest to the older Shin Megami Tensei games, since it has first-person blobber-style dungeon exploration, though overworld exploration is conducted via an isometric third-person perspective.
Persona 2: Innocent Sin released in 1999, also for the original PlayStation. It replaces first-person dungeon crawling with third-person exploration.

Both games are definitely worth saving from obscurity: I wouldn't necessarily advocate for full-scale remakes, but reissues with a bit of spit and polish would definitely be welcome, especially if, as Wada says, the motive is preservation.
points: Atlus will probably remake Persona 1 and 2 one day, according to a new interview with series producer Kazuhisa Wada conducted by Rock Paper Shotgun.
"For me, I think a remaster or remake is some kind of cultural preservation," Wada said.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda's Best Amiibo Finally Arrives This Month
articles.summary: Back in May, to mark the third anniversary of the release of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Nintendo unveiled a new amiibo figure tied to the game, due this month. It might be the best Tears of the Kingdom figurine yet.
body: Nintendo's new Mineru's Construct amiibo will be available starting Sept. 17. It's a relatively large-scale figure representing the ancient Zonai robot originally used by the Sage of Spirit, Mineru, and rebuilt and commanded by Link toward the end of the game's storyline.
Best of all, it has fully articulated, posable arms! "There's a fair bit of freedom to its movement too, so try making it pose in a way that looks good to you," recommends Nintendo, helpfully.

As with other amiibo, tapping the Mineru's Construct on your Switch's NFC reader will reward you with helpful items in-game. Notably, there's a chance to get a special fabric for Link's paraglider with a Mineru's Construct theme and glow-in-the-dark elements.

It's anyone's guess why Nintendo is choosing to release the Mineru's Construct amiibo almost three years after the game (and a year after its Switch 2 edition of Tears of the Kingdom ). Although it's worth noting that the very existence of the Construct could be considered a late-game spoiler for Tears of the Kingdom.

articles.title: Persona 1 and 2 remakes are "something we'll probably eventually do," series producer says
articles.summary: With Persona 3 Reload out the door and Persona 4 Revival next in line, series producer Kazuhisa Wada has said remakes of the first two games will "probably" happen as well.
body: Developer Atlus seems to be on a mission to revisit every high-schooling, demon-mashing, double-life-simulating game it's ever made. In 2024, the studio pulled the gun on Persona 3 Reload before starting work on Persona 4 Revival, coming next February. But Atlus may reach even further back for some new (old) source material.

In an interview with RPS, Wada said the team originally came up with the idea to remake Persona 3 and Persona 4 around the same time. The latter "had to be put" on the backburner for a while, but the intent for both was the same. "I think a remaster or remake is some kind of cultural preservation," he said, per a translator.

Wada continued to explain that it's Atlus' "duty" to make sure its older games aren't lost to time "and are still around in the modern day." With that in mind, "Persona 1 and 2 are something we'll probably eventually do, too." There you have it, folks.

Persona 1 and Persona 2 are also the only mainline games in the series that aren't readily available to buy on any modern system, making Wada's point about "cultural preservation" even more salient here.
points: With Persona 3 Reload out the door and Persona 4 Revival next in line, series producer Kazuhisa Wada has said remakes of the first two games will "probably" happen as well.

articles.title: Final Fantasy Resonance modders have already reinstated the original mobile game's biggest icon, Ariana Grande
articles.summary: Final Fantasy Resonance doesn't launch in full until next month, but modders are already using its new demo to reinstate the series' most iconic diva. I'm talking about Ariana Grande, of course.
body: For those not in the know, Final Fantasy Resonance is an almost unrecognisable reconstruction of the now-shuttered mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. It's not exactly a port or a remake, but it's using the original game's story as a jumping off point.

And one of Final Fantasy Resonance's most unique ideas comes from Visions, characters from across the series' history who you can summon in battle. Cloud and Lightning and Cecil can all lend you a helping hand while in combat, but modders have now taken things a step further by adding every Brave Exvius fighter who didn't make it onto Resonance's roster.

The FFR Vision Studio mod brings almost 1,300 Brave Exvius units into the upcoming game's demo as Visions. That means every guest character from the defunct mobile game can theoretically show up, Kingdom Hearts ' Sora and Nier Automata's 2B included.
points: Final Fantasy Resonance doesn't launch in full until next month, but modders are already using its new demo to reinstate the series' most iconic diva.

articles.title: GTA 6's Criminal Profile system sounds pretty interesting, includes a 'shattered' state for players who DGAF
articles.summary: The fidelity of Grand Theft Auto 6's world makes random violence look considerably less silly than it did when the characters had boxy claws for hands, but Rockstar isn't stopping players from doing what they want in Vice City and its environs.
body: We know that because we've seen the GTA 6 leaker shoot up a nudist party, murder the residents of a homeless encampment, and beat a delivery driver to death—quite a contrast with the mission-focused gameplay in the official reveal.

A little devil icon in one of the leaked videos did lead us to wonder if GTA 6 would judge us for antisocial behavior, a la Red Dead Redemption 2's Honor system, but the details that have come out since the reveal suggest that 'Criminal Profiles' aren't quite like that.

According to a preview from TGG on YouTube (embedded above), Rockstar doesn't want to punish players for how they play, or create a situation where they have to grind their reputation up to a 'better' level in order to progress.

This all aligns with IGN's learnings, but adds a few new specifics. What neither source came away with are specifics about how or how much Criminal Profiles will affect the story—will it lead to different endings, or just slightly change how NPCs interact with us?—but a comment from GTA 6 co-studio head Rob Nelson suggests that we will notice the effects of our actions.

articles.title: Two years after its rocky launch, Civilization 7's first paid expansion Earthrise is on its way - but first comes the atomic age
articles.summary: It's been a bumpy ride for Civilization 7, but two years after its widely criticised launch - and as the legendary 4X series celebrates its 35th anniversary - developer Firaxis has unveiled a host of new updates coming to the game.
body: Starting with the free Arc of Tomorrow update, it finally drags Civ 7's current end-game into more contemporary times. It introduces a new age, the Atomic Age, extending the current playable timeline from the 1950s into the near future, and adds period-specific gameplay, alongside new buildings, units, visuals, and more. As with other Ages, it'll be possible to begin a game straight from in the Atomic Age, or go the long way round, starting in Antiquity.

As to what the Atomic Age brings, there're new civilisations and leaders, as well as expanded nuclear gameplay options, including "a fun twist on mutually assured destruction." New Multilateral Agreements enable leaders to "collectively react to developing situations - like a growing stockpile of nuclear warheads - with calls for disarmament or escalation", and new empire management tools provide options such as the ability to transform Settlements into new City-States. Among other things, City-States enable Proxy Warfare focused on smaller-scale conflicts rather than all-out empire warfare.

articles.title: New Super Smash Bros and Nintendogs games are on the way, according to prominent Nintendo leaker
articles.summary: A prominent Nintendo leaker has spilled even more information about the console maker's potential plans, which include the long-awaited return of Nintendogs and an all-new Super Smash Bros. game ( not a buffed up version of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, apparently.)
body: The scoop comes from the ever-enigmatic Malo932, who first leaked that the company was preparing two back-to-back Nintendo Directs well before the Big N had the chance to tell us itself. They were also the first to claim that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, a new Star Fox and a Switch Sports game would come out this year, weeks before they were all properly revealed to the world.

News of another Super Smash Bros. game isn't super surprising - 2018's Super Smash Bros. Ultimate is the genre's best-selling game ever, and one of the original Switch console's defining hits. Series director Masahiro Sakurai has also been pretty quiet ever since wrapping up work on Kirby Air Riders last year.

In a now-deleted YouTube comment that was quickly shared by eagle-eyed fans (I managed to catch a peek at it over the weekend), the leaker also teased that another "cozy weird Nintendo series is coming back, barking. Wink wink, woof woof."

articles.title: Capcom expresses continued interest in 're-activating IPs' as the first new Onimusha game in 20 years surpasses 1 million sales on launch day
articles.summary: Samurai adventure Onimusha: Way of the Sword notched over a million sales on its launch day, Capcom has announced. The success is deserved, per our reviewer Wes, who said that Way of the Sword "whips ass" in his 83/100 review.
body: According to Capcom, the one million launch day sales for Way of the Sword has put the Onimusha series as a whole at 10 million lifetime sales. The last new game in the main series was Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, which released 20 years ago.

"In addition to regularly releasing major new titles each year, Capcom is focusing on re-activating IPs that haven't had a new title launch recently," the developer said. "The company is working to further maximize corporate value by leveraging its rich library of content, including this title."

It's become a cliche to say that Capcom's on a bit of a run lately, but here's yet another mile marker in the developer's 2020s streak, which has included a pair of well-liked Resident Evil remakes, two new Resident Evil games, Monster Hunter Rise and Wilds, Pragmata, Street Fighter 6, and Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess, among other games.
